raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Install `vllm_xpu_kernels` for XPU from the project's GitHub Pages wheel index instead of the previously pinned `0.1.16.2` version.

## Claims

- `requirements/xpu.txt` adds `--extra-index-url=https://vllm-project.github.io/vllm-xpu-kernels/whl` and pins `vllm_xpu_kernels==0.1.16`.

## Validation

- Not yet run: `uv pip install -r requirements/xpu.txt` on an XPU environment (to be confirmed by the submitter before merge).

## Details

Requirements-only change (no runtime code). No overlapping open PR was found by searching open PRs for XPU kernel changes.
